_doc: Tech cards (D13/D15/S05/S06). kinds = hybrid BUILD_MENU kinds; units = unit kinds a building may queue; wl_patterns = substrings of imported Widelands building names ('wl:<tribe>_<name>') that the card unlocks for every tribe; requires_cards = drafted first; requires_working = building kinds of the faction that must be operational at draft time (S06 physical prerequisite). era is an index: 0 prehistoric, 1 historic, 2 modern, 3 dystopian. v2 (12 Oct 2026): 32 cards over four eras; up to tech.OFFER_SIZE (7) eligible cards are offered per round; summary is the player-facing explanation; effect is an optional non-content modifier.

cards.name: Farming
cards.summary: Fields of grain, cassava or corn: the base of bread, beer and rations.

cards.name: Mining
cards.summary: Shafts into coal, iron, gold and stone deposits. The sites never run dry (D22); miners need rations.

cards.name: Cookery
cards.summary: Taverns and bakeries turn meat, fish and bread into rations that feed miners and soldiers.

cards.name: Smelting
cards.summary: Furnaces turn ore and coal into iron and gold; charcoal kilns burn logs into coal.

cards.name: Warrior bands
cards.summary: A war lodge trains clubmen and spearmen from rations and wood.

cards.name: Slings
cards.summary: Slingers fight from range; trained at the war lodge.

cards.name: Settlers
cards.summary: A warehouse can send out a settlers' wagon that founds a new settlement (+1 VP).

cards.name: Crafts
cards.summary: Reed yards, rope weavers, wood hardeners, lime kilns, brick kilns and masons: the special building materials of each tribe.

cards.name: Husbandry
cards.summary: Pig, sheep, reindeer, cattle, tapir and bee farms, fish breeders and fruit collectors.

cards.name: Metalwork
cards.summary: Smithies forge tools, axes, swords and armour from iron and coal.

cards.name: Weaving
cards.summary: Weaving mills, sewing rooms, tailors and dressmakers: cloth, tabards and garments for soldiers.

cards.name: Drill tactics
cards.summary: OpenRA barracks: riflemen equipped with the tribe's own weapons (or axes).

cards.name: Grenadiers
cards.summary: Grenadiers (OpenRA E2) throw explosives over cover; cost iron and coal.

cards.name: Rocketry
cards.summary: Rocket soldiers (OpenRA E3) with anti-armour launchers.

cards.name: Fortification
cards.summary: Gun turrets and flame towers guard the approaches to a settlement.

cards.name: Motor pool
cards.summary: War factory: jeeps, light tanks and the MCV that founds distant settlements.

cards.name: Armour
cards.summary: Medium and heavy tanks and armoured personnel carriers.

cards.name: Artillery
cards.summary: Long-range artillery shells buildings from beyond turret range.

cards.name: Seafaring
cards.summary: Naval yards and patrol boats; Widelands shipyards and ports.

cards.name: Automation
cards.summary: Mindustry drills on the existing deposits, conveyors and power: machines that work without carriers.

cards.name: Industry
cards.summary: Silicon smelters, graphite presses, batteries, pneumatic drills and large solar panels.

cards.name: Unit fabrication
cards.summary: The Mindustry ground factory builds daggers from silicon and lead, powered by the grid.

cards.name: Heavy armour
cards.summary: Mammoth tanks (OpenRA 4TNK): the strongest armour of the age.

cards.name: Rocket artillery
cards.summary: V2 rocket launchers outrange every defence.

cards.name: Tesla coils
cards.summary: Tesla coils: a high-voltage defence that destroys armour.

cards.name: Submarines
cards.summary: Submarine pens and submarines.

cards.name: Deep mining
cards.summary: Deeper Widelands mines that feed on snacks and meals and dig faster.

cards.name: Tesla armour
cards.summary: Tesla tanks carry the coil into battle.

cards.name: Phase armour
cards.summary: Phase transports and chrono tanks with armour-piercing tusks.

cards.name: Shock troops
cards.summary: Shock troopers armed with portable tesla guns.

cards.name: Machine war
cards.summary: Ground factories also build crawlers and novas; daggers come off the line faster.

cards.name: Arcologies
cards.summary: Dense settlements: every command centre may support more buildings and its territory grows by 4 tiles.
